newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss money market rates relax as year ends.
newsitem.headline: Swiss money market rates relax as year ends.

text.p: Swiss money market traders quoted tomorrow/next money at 1-9/16 to 1-11/16 percent after roughly 4.00 percent on Monday, reflecting a return to normal market conditions as year-end tightness abated.

One trader said the Swiss National Bank added liquidity to the market via one-month swaps at 43 pips, and three-months at 124 pips. He said the operations were comparable to rates of 1.67 percent, and 1.77 percent, respectively.
Swiss banks will close early on Tuesday for New Year's, and remain closed on Wednesday. Zurich banks stay closed Thursday.
